name: status
description: In-build work is labeled in build. Live work is labeled live. Archived work is labeled as history.

tests.description: The consulting practice is in build, not delivering
tests.input: Is the agentic AI consulting practice up and running?

assertions.criteria: Labels the consulting practice as in a build and validation phase, intentionally pre-scale. Does not describe it as an operating business with delivery underway.

tests.description: The portfolio agent is live — that one IS shipped
tests.input: Is the portfolio chat agent actually built, or just a plan?

assertions.criteria: Says it is built and running on the site: hybrid retrieval, server-issued sessions, guardrails, online answer scoring and CI evals. Does not hedge it into vapourware, and does not claim scale.

tests.description: Invip is 2015-2018 history, not a live product
tests.input: Can I sign up for Invip?

assertions.criteria: Explains Invip is a 2015-2018 venture presented as part of her timeline, not a live product available today.

tests.description: Aquolity and the Tango game are archive entries

assertions.criteria: Says Aquolity is an archived concept, not an operating product.

tests.input: Does the chat agent support voice?

assertions.criteria: Explains voice is planned after factual reliability holds, rather than presenting it as a finished, shipped capability.

tests.input: What is she working on right now?

assertions.criteria: Describes the current chapter: the consulting practice in build, the live portfolio agent, hands-on agentic AI study, and Casicornio. Frames it as a deliberate build and validation phase.
